title: Weighted boxes fusion: Ensembling boxes from different object detection models
why_relevant: WBF is a practical post-processing ensemble that often improves mAP for detection-style submissions with minimal retraining.
extracted_technique: Fuse overlapping per-class boxes from multiple detectors/TTAs using confidence-weighted averaging instead of suppressing (NMS).
takeaway: Use WBF after per-model inference (and light TTA) to lift mAP; tune IoU match threshold and per-model weights; keep per-class fusion separate.

title: Home - Ultralytics YOLO Docs
why_relevant: Provides a stable, well-supported training/inference stack for YOLO models that matches YOLO-format labels and supports mAP reporting and GPU training.
extracted_technique: Train high-capacity YOLO detectors with configurable image size, augmentation, and mixed precision; export predictions for custom evaluation/submission formatting.
query: Ultralytics YOLOv8 documentation training custom dataset COCO mAP
takeaway: YOLOv8-style pipelines are fast to iterate and strong for small/medium datasets; combine larger imgsz + longer schedule + careful augmentation for accuracy.

title: Albumentations Documentation: Working with Multiple Data Targets
why_relevant: Strong, reproducible augmentation library that safely applies identical spatial transforms to images and bounding boxes, improving detector generalization without label corruption.
extracted_technique: Use bbox-aware augmentation pipelines (bbox_params) so flips/scales/crops update YOLO/COCO boxes consistently; keep transforms fold-safe.
takeaway: Prefer bbox-synchronized augmentations for detection; aggressively augment spatially while maintaining valid boxes to improve mAP and robustness.

title: Mean Average Precision (mAP) Explained
why_relevant: Clarifies COCO-style mAP@0.5:0.95 and how it differs from single-threshold AP, informing correct local validation for the detection component.
extracted_technique: Evaluate detectors using the primary COCO AP averaged over IoU thresholds 0.50:0.05:0.95; track AP50/AP75 as diagnostic slices.
query: mean average precision mAP 0.5:0.95 COCO metrics explained
takeaway: Use COCO-style averaged AP for model selection; optimize localization (not just AP50) and watch small-object behavior when tuning augmentations/image size.
